arm1_isolated.isolation: only case 9 survives in the >=4096 crossrow switch, so the cell under test is the only crossrow body the shared allocation must cover. Census: entry heuristic 135 (iso3) vs 181 (iso5), against 163 for the shipped table.
arm1_isolated.readout: T(9) = sum over the 8 scored shapes of calls_per_verify * seconds_per_call, ms, identical to E46.

arm2_shared.dose_knob: an unreachable `case 10:` in the >=4096 switch. ntg.x == M and the workload never verifies more than 9 rows, so the cell is compiled and allocated for but never executed: no dispatched width's instructions change.

doses.role: null: adds a branch WITHOUT raising the max. Reproduces E38 arm (b)'s null (117 under a 129 ceiling, no tax). Predicted 0 %; it is also the contention detector, because a peer student's GPU work would inflate this arm exactly like a real tax.
dose-response: if the 108->129 interval contains a step, a larger dose must not be smaller.
a dose we cannot have missed. A null here refutes the mechanism far more strongly than a null at 129 alone.
composite: E27's own M=9 edit. Falsifies composite == local + tax rather than assuming it.

arm2_shared.ordering: palindromic within a session so every arm has the same mean sweep position and linear thermal drift cancels; the null is interleaved between positive doses, never run once at the start.
arm2_shared.prediction_kind: integral across 108 -> 129, not a per-register slope

decision_rules.arm1_eaten: delta_pct(9) >= -2 % => H_local_eaten. STOP. Do not run arm 2; report that ledger 173(C)'s largest roadmap item does not exist.
decision_rules.arm1_local_win: delta_pct(9) <= -8 % => the 2-stream prize is real in isolation; run arm 2.
decision_rules.arm1_middle: -8 % < delta_pct(9) < -2 % => a partial local win. Report the interval and still run arm 2, because the tax question stays decision-relevant at any non-zero local win.
decision_rules.arm2_confirmed: pooled tax over untouched widths >= +8 % at dose_129 => 173(C)'s attribution is confirmed. STOP; the follow-up is a design problem, not a measurement.
decision_rules.arm2_invalid: |tax| > 2 % on dose_null invalidates the ladder: either the harness moves under a recompile alone, or something else was on the GPU. Report and do not interpret the positive doses.
decision_rules.arm2_refuted: |pooled tax| <= 2 % at dose_129 AND at the larger doses => 173(C) is refuted and E27's loss is something else.
decision_rules.control_bar: the largest |delta_pct| on any width whose code is byte-identical between the two builds. E46's worst untreated control was +6.41 % at M=1 (a warmup width) and <=0.4 % everywhere else.
decision_rules.no_significance_chasing: reps buy precision, only the design buys power. No arm is extended to chase a p-value.
decision_rules.replicate_floor: MDE(M) = max(|T_a1 - T_a2|, |T_b1 - T_b2|) over the same-build replicates, as E46. With n=2 the honest floor is the observed same-build spread, not a t-statistic.

instrument_honesty.contention: MLXFAST_LOCAL_RUN_LOCK_DIR=/tmp/mlxfast-shared so the run lock is shared with askeladd's PR 52, plus a per-leg AGXAccelerator utilization gate whose first (interval) sample is discarded and which requires 3 consecutive busy samples. The gate is self-tested against real Metal load in both directions before any leg is trusted.
instrument_honesty.register_readout: There is no true register or occupancy readout on this box (ledger 157). peak_live_regs is a textual peak-live-SSA heuristic; it is used ONLY to choose and order the doses, never as a result.
instrument_honesty.scored_surface: Every arm patches quantized.h and its generated twin and reverts them on every exit path. The branch keeps zero scored-surface diff versus the frontier.
instrument_honesty.thermal: This host's idle GPU floor is ~43.2 C, above benchmark.sh's 40 C target, so every leg records cool_gate_passed_real_gate=false and gate_qualified_for_timing=false. Directional causal evidence inside one counterbalanced session only; never a ranked or gate-qualified score.
instrument_honesty.timing_readout: research/run-qmv-curve.sh, the same harness and the same T(M) definition as E46, so E46's numbers are directly comparable.
